name: start-plan-choice-card
query: Help me plan our customer meetup in Austin: about 40 people, Feb 26, 2027, budget $5,000. Dana and I are organizing. No venue yet, and we want a short talk plus networking.

context.conversation: No destination named. The user has never mentioned Notion databases.

search_routes.intent: Find an existing meetup plan, Projects or Tasks database

success_criteria: Before building, shows exactly one setup card through the ask-user-question tool (not plain text): 'Project with tasks' first and marked Recommended, 'Simple checklist' second, each with its full one-line description.

After the choice, builds one private plan page with a Tasks database inside it (Status, Owner, Due, plus at most two fitting fields) and a board or open-work view plus a 'Needs a date' view; no Projects database is created.

Task pages contain real content (e.g. venue requirements, a timed run-of-show draft); dates are labeled as proposed; no venue, vendor, price or attendee is invented; 'Dana' is resolved to the matching account only when unique, otherwise kept as text.
The delivery explains how the plan is organized once in one or two sentences (tasks are a database; the views show the same tasks) and gives one next action with a date.

After delivery, shows one multi-select choice card for useful additions with 2-4 options that fit an event (e.g. calendar view, RSVP form, share with Dana, invite designs, kickoff on the calendar); no Vercel/site option, no option without a description.
Sends, books, invites and shares nothing without a separate explicit yes.
If the RSVP form is chosen, creates a real form view on a private Guests database (not a manual step). Sharing and calendar invitations are previewed and saved only after an explicit yes.

Pins the new plan to Favorites by default and says so in one line; a plan spanning months may offer 'Keep it moving' only if the client can schedule, and creates no schedule without a confirmed day and time.
